11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager still feels irritated about a tiny scratch a friend left on a borrowed basket three weeks ago.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Three weeks ago, (friend) borrowed (subject)'s favorite basket and returned it with a small scratch. (subject) said it was fine. It was, in fact, fine. Nevertheless, every time (subject) sees the scratch, (subject.he/she) remembers the incident and feels mildly irritated.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "That scratch?" says (friend). "I thought you said it was fine." "It is fine," replies (subject). They stare at each other. Then (subject) laughs. "I think I've been annoyed about a basket for three weeks." (friend) agrees that this is a rather long time.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) carries the basket to the fields. By the end of the day it has acquired two more scratches. (subject.He/She) looks at all three and decides the basket has become rather distinguished.
